response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/generalist engineer with ~19 years across web, mobile, and embedded systems, satisfying the base experience requirement, but he lacks the deep AI specialization, cloud strategy expertise, and director-level strategic advisory experience this Principal Engineer role demands. His AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work at his current job, with no track record of building or shipping AI products/platforms, advising strategic customers, or operating at a director-level scope.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured technical background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure engineering
Demonstrated thought-leadership habits via talks, workshops, and open-source contributions (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Entrepreneurial mindset shown through founding and maintaining an open-source geo-data platform since 2016
concerns: Minimal and very recent AI/ML experience (only since April 2025), with no demonstrated AI products or platforms at scale
Career trajectory shows senior/staff-level IC roles, not clear evidence of director-level strategic influence or executive-level stakeholder engagement
No advanced degree or specialized credential in AI, and limited depth in cloud architecture/strategy beyond incidental AWS/Kubernetes usage
